say:2:1064401001:0.source_cn: 是阿尔娜将军，她回来啦！

say:4:1064401002:0.text: Thanks to Alna, the wolves and bandits are kept at bay. <style="highlight">Resford</style> will enjoy another peaceful winter this year!
say:4:1064401002:0.source_cn: 诸神保佑，多亏了阿尔娜，北地的狼群和匪患才不敢靠近<s...

say:5:1064401003:0.text: General Alna! When I grow up, I want to be a hero just like you!
say:5:1064401003:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜将军！我以后也要像您一样，骑着大马，拿着长枪，保...

say:6:1064401004:0.text: The little girl dashes toward Alna excitedly, only for her mother to pull her back with an apologetic smile.
say:6:1064401004:0.source_cn: 孩童兴奋地冲到阿尔娜身前，身后的母亲急忙拉住她，对阿尔...

say:10:1064401005:1.text: Little one, that dream can wait. You're still young, so stay close to your mother, alright?
say:10:1064401005:1.source_cn: 小家伙，握紧武器之前，先学会抓牢母亲的手。

say:11:1064401006:1.text: One day, when you've grown up and trained hard, you'll be strong enough to protect Resford.
say:11:1064401006:1.source_cn: 然后努力变强，安息城需要每一份力量。

say:13:1064401007:0.text: Alna rides past the welcoming crowd atop her mount. As she enters the city, a high-ranking official steps forward to greet her.
say:13:1064401007:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜驱马穿过欢迎她的人群，未曾停留。入城后，一位高官迎来。

say:16:1064401008:0.text: Congratulations on your victory, General Alna! Not even the blizzards could hold you back!
say:16:1064401008:0.source_cn: 祝贺将军凯旋，看来北地的风雪，又一次为您让出了道路。

say:17:1064401009:0.text: Lord Sno sends his regards and has entrusted me with the rewards he prepared for you. General, please have a—
say:17:1064401009:0.source_cn: 领主大人本想亲自迎接，只是近日为城邦事务辛劳过度，此刻...

say:18:1064401010:0.text:
Dunn, take inventory.
See to the families of the fallen first, then distribute the rest to the soldiers based on merit.
say:18:1064401010:0.source_cn: 邓恩，全部登记。\n按军功分给出征士兵，尤其是阵亡者的遗属。

say:22:1064401012:0.text: W-Wait... General, these rewards are meant for you alone. It wouldn't be appropriate to give them away.
say:22:1064401012:0.source_cn: 这……将军，这是领主大人对您一人的赏赐，于礼不合。

say:23:1064401013:0.text:
This is what I've always done.
My duties await. Please excuse me.
say:23:1064401013:0.source_cn: 这是惯例。\n军队有待巡视，不奉陪了。

say:24:1064401014:0.text: General, your dedication is certainly admirable, but I've prepared a banquet in your honor this evening. Once Lord Sno awakens...
say:24:1064401014:0.source_cn: 将军忠于职守，无可指摘。只是鞍马劳顿，我已备下晚宴，待...

say:28:1064401016:0.text: At dusk, two soldiers stand guard at the Resford's eastern gate. One of them, finding the cold unbearable, prepares to leave.
say:28:1064401016:0.source_cn: 傍晚时分，安息城东门，两名执勤士兵挺立，其中一人搓了搓...

say:30:1064401017:0.text: Raymond, we can't leave our post until the relief arrives.
say:30:1064401017:0.source_cn: 莱默尔，换岗的人还没来，按军规，不能随便离开城门。

say:32:1064401018:1.text: Um... I was only checking whether our replacements were on their way. Relax, the enemy won't be coming out in weather like this...
say:32:1064401018:1.source_cn: 呃……我就是打算去营里催一声，大冷天的，敌人不会碰巧在...

say:36:1064401019:0.source_cn: 大人——城里的大人们！行行好，放我们进城吧！

say:37:1064401020:0.text: Who's there?! Step into the light so I can see you! How many of you are there? Is anyone ill?
say:37:1064401020:0.source_cn: 谁？！站到火光里来，让我看清人数！有没有人身患疾病？

say:38:1064401021:0.text: <style="highlight">Hypofiends</style>! There are Hypofiends right behind us!!! Please let us in! We just need a shelter!

say:39:1064401022:0.text: Hypofiend? What's that? Raymond, keep an eye on them. I'll notify General Alna.
say:39:1064401022:0.source_cn: 魔物？那是什么？莱默尔，看好他们，我去通报阿尔娜将军。

say:44:1064401024:1.text:
Keep your head up, sir.
Could you tell me about yourself? And what exactly is a Hypofiend?
say:44:1064401024:1.source_cn: 老人家，抬起头来。\n说清楚，你们来自哪里？途径何处？...

say:45:1064401025:1.text:
Madam, we're from Buckham in the south.
Buckham, Macyland, and Castleville... They're all gone! We kept running north, and didn't stop until we made it here.
say:45:1064401025:1.source_cn: 大人，我们是南边巴克村的。\n村子，还有梅卡镇、卡索城...

say:46:1064401026:1.text: Those Hypofiends... Some had horns, while others crawled straight out of the ground. They slaughtered everyone they saw, and our farm tools couldn't even leave a scratch on them!
say:46:1064401026:1.source_cn: 那些魔物，有的长角，有的从地底下钻出来，见到人就杀，农...

say:47:1064401027:1.text: Please, let us in... I'm begging you.
say:47:1064401027:1.source_cn: 求求大人，放我们进城吧……

say:48:1064401028:1.text:
Russell, open the gate. Give them soup and blankets.
I don't think they're dangerous. No enemy would send the elderly and children to scout ahead in weather like this.
say:48:1064401028:1.source_cn: 罗塞，放他们进城，分发热汤和毛毯。\n若是敌军伪装，不...

say:49:1064401029:1.text: Dunn, dispatch three scout teams to Buckham, Macyland, and Castleville tonight. I want a full report on the situation.
say:49:1064401029:1.source_cn: 邓恩，派三队斥候，今夜出城，到巴克村、梅卡镇、卡索城，...

say:55:1064401031:0.text: And Raymond, your shift is extended until dawn.
say:55:1064401031:0.source_cn: 莱默尔，你的值守时间延长到天明。

say:56:1064401032:0.text: Remember, the city gates are the heart of Resford. There's no place in my army for soldiers who neglect their duty.
say:56:1064401032:0.source_cn: 记住，城门是安息城的心脏，军队不需要疏忽职守的士兵！

say:57:1064401033:1.text: I'm sorry, General! I'll keep that in mind!
say:57:1064401033:1.source_cn: 对不起，将军，我以后不会再犯！

say:1:1064402001:0.text: Night descends on Resford. Though the wind still rages outside, the city is bathed in warmth and light. From Lord Sno's castle come the sounds of laughter and clinking glasses.
say:1:1064402001:0.source_cn: 夜幕笼罩北地，风雪呼号。安息城内温暖明亮，领主城堡方向...

say:2:1064402002:0.text: Instead of attending the banquet held in her honor, Alna remains at the city gate, gazing into the darkness beyond the walls. A thin layer of snow settles over her armor.
say:2:1064402002:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜没有参加为她而设的宴会，她立于城门，凝视城外受风...

say:5:1064402003:0.text: General, two more groups of refugees have arrived from the south. According to them, the Hypofiends that destroyed their villages are advancing north.
say:5:1064402003:0.source_cn: 将军，又来了两批南方流民。他们都提到有屠戮村庄的魔物，...

say:6:1064402004:1.text: And we still haven't heard from the scout teams we sent out yesterday. Maybe the blizzard's too severe...
say:6:1064402004:1.source_cn: 另外，昨天派出去的三队斥候，还没有任何音讯。风雪太大了...

say:7:1064402005:1.text:
There may be other factors at play.
Anyway, take the refugees in and help them settle down.
say:7:1064402005:1.source_cn: 也许并非风雪。\n接收流民，按此前的要求安置。

say:8:1064402006:1.text: Double the guard at all city gates. Report any unusual activity at once.
say:8:1064402006:1.source_cn: 向城门加派双倍人手，有任何异动，立刻示警。

say:10:1064402007:0.text: As the blizzard briefly subsides, a hooded figure emerges from the snowy plains, staff in hand.
say:10:1064402007:0.source_cn: 风雪稍歇的间隙，一个戴着兜帽、手持法杖的身影自雪原中出现。

say:13:1064402009:0.text: General, I'm Merlin, a mage from the south. Please inform your ruler that I have important news concerning Resford's survival.
say:13:1064402009:0.source_cn: 将军，我名为梅林，一名自南方而来的魔法师。请代为通报领...

say:14:1064402010:0.text: I understand it's difficult to trust a stranger. You're wondering what became of your scouts, aren't you? I found their bodies in the south.
say:14:1064402010:0.source_cn: 我知晓您此刻心存疑虑，但您派出的斥候，我在南方见到了他...

say:15:1064402011:0.text: If you let me in, I can help you defend Resford against the Hypofiends.
say:15:1064402011:0.source_cn: 让我进城，或许能在灾厄降临前，筑起一线生机。

narration:16:1064402012:0.text: Alna studies the poised figure outside the city for a moment before inviting her into her tent.
narration:16:1064402012:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜审视城外平静的身影，片刻后，她将其带入营帐中

say:18:1064402013:0.text: Thank you for receiving me, General...

say:19:1064402014:1.text: Skip the formalities. Just tell me what you know. If you utter a single lie, you'll be banished.
say:19:1064402014:1.source_cn: 免去客套，直说你知晓的消息。记住，若有半分谎言，你将会...

say:20:1064402015:1.text: A powerful Hypogean has awakened from the abyss. It has rallied a vast army of Hypofiends and is now advancing north from the south.
say:20:1064402015:1.source_cn: 源于深渊的意志已然苏醒，恶魔正驱策魔物大军，自南方向北席卷。

say:21:1064402016:1.text: Neither mortal weapons nor the bitter cold can stop them. Wherever they pass, they leave nothing behind but death and ruin.
say:21:1064402016:1.source_cn: 它们不惧凡人的武器，不畏北地严寒，所过之处，生灵涂炭。

say:22:1064402017:0.text:
Why should I trust you?
You're a complete stranger, showing up right as my city faces a crisis.
say:22:1064402017:0.source_cn: 我为何要相信你？\n一个来历不明，在我军情紧急之时，突...

say:24:1064402018:0.text: In response, Merlin begins chanting a spell. A vision unfolds before everyone, revealing hideous Hypofiends tearing humans apart as cries of despair echo in every direction.
say:24:1064402018:0.source_cn: 梅林吟咏咒语，浮现出魔法影像：样貌扭曲的魔物轻易撕开人...

say:25:1064402019:1.text: The towers of Castleville collapse into ruins beneath torrents of fire. Dried blood blankets the streets of Macyland, and the bodies of Resford's scouts lie scattered across Buckham.
say:25:1064402019:1.source_cn: 卡索城的塔楼在魔物喷出的火焰中化为残垣，梅卡镇尽是冻结...

say:26:1064402020:0.text: Even Alna, a battlefield veteran, is shaken by the horrifying sight.
say:26:1064402020:0.source_cn: 纵然阿尔娜饱经沙场，但那些扭曲的形态与纯粹的恶意，让她...

say:28:1064402021:0.text: Resford is a thriving commercial hub with immense wealth, making it too tempting a target for the Hypofiends to ignore.
say:28:1064402021:0.source_cn: 安息城，北地富饶的商陆核心，堆积如山的财富，对渴求掠夺...

say:29:1064402022:0.text: At their current pace, they'll reach your gates in no more than five days.
say:29:1064402022:0.source_cn: 以魔物大军的行进速度，最多五日，便会到达安息城外。

say:30:1064402023:0.text: ... Very well, Merlin. How do you propose to help us?
say:30:1064402023:0.source_cn: ……嗯。那么，梅林，你所说的一线生机是什么？

say:31:1064402024:1.text: Surely you didn't travel all this way just to tell us we're finished.
say:31:1064402024:1.source_cn: 你穿越魔潮来到北地，总不会只是为了告诉我死期将至。

say:32:1064402025:1.text: Merlin produces a fist-sized crystal. The moment it appears, the flames in the furnaces flicker and dim.
say:32:1064402025:1.source_cn: 梅林取出一枚拳头大小的冰晶，它出现的瞬间，火炉中的焰火...

say:33:1064402026:1.text: This is the <style="highlight">Seed of Frost</style>, the last crystallization of the Winter Goddess' divinity before her demise.

say:34:1064402027:1.text: Through <style="highlight">divine resonance</style>, it responds to <style="highlight">glacite</style> and to <style="highlight">those of exceptionally strong will</style>.

say:35:1064402028:1.text: By fusing the Seed of Frost with glacite through magic, we can raise an ice barrier around Resford strong enough to repel the Hypofiend horde.
say:35:1064402028:1.source_cn: 以它为核心，借助魔法融合冰蓝晶，可在安息城外，构筑一道...

say:36:1064402029:0.text: Alna's blood surges, and <style="highlight">for a fleeting moment, she hears something calling out to her.</style>
say:36:1064402029:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜感到血液似乎流动得稍快了一些，<style=hi...

say:38:1064402030:0.text: Dunn, fetch some glacite from the vault.
say:38:1064402030:0.source_cn: 邓恩，去财库，取冰蓝晶来。

say:40:1064402031:0.text: General, glacite is extremely valuable. We'll need a written order from the finance officer to access it...
say:40:1064402031:0.source_cn: 将军，冰蓝晶可是极为珍贵的材料，每一克都登记在册，需要...

say:41:1064402032:0.text: Go ahead and do whatever it takes! If anything goes wrong, I'll take full responsibility.
say:41:1064402032:0.source_cn: 那就去找财政官！所有责任我来承担。

narration:43:1064402033:0.text: A few hours later, Dunn returns with a small amount of glacite dust.
narration:43:1064402033:0.source_cn: 数小时后，邓恩带回少量冰蓝晶粉末

say:44:1064402034:0.text: Show me the barrier here, Merlin. Make it as big as you can.
say:44:1064402034:0.source_cn: 在这里，筑起你能做到的最大屏障，梅林。

say:45:1064402035:0.text: I'll see for myself how strong it really is.
say:45:1064402035:0.source_cn: 我要亲自验证冰封之墙的防御能力。

say:46:1064402036:0.text: Merlin recites another spell, and glacite dust swirls around the glowing Seed of Frost, forming a barrier of ice.
say:46:1064402036:0.source_cn: 梅林再次吟咏咒语，冰蓝晶粉末环绕微亮的寒冰之种，随后洒...

say:51:1064402037:0.text: Alna drives her spear into the ice with all her might, yet fails to leave even a scratch.
say:51:1064402037:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜全力刺向冰层，然而，曾无数次冲破敌阵的力量，甚至...

say:56:1064402039:0.text: Alna charges forward again, but the ice refuses to budge.
say:56:1064402039:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜再次发力，这一次，冰层依然纹丝未动。

say:57:1064402040:1.text: <style="highlight">Then, she hears the voice again. The Seed of Frost seems to resonate with her.</style>

say:58:1064402041:1.text:
...
How much glacite would it take to shield the entire city?
say:58:1064402041:1.source_cn: ……\n构筑足以保护整个安息城的冰封之墙，需要多少冰蓝晶？

say:59:1064402042:1.text: Enough to all but empty your city's coffers. That's why I need an audience with your ruler. Without his support, Resford will suffer the same fate as the cities to the south.
say:59:1064402042:1.source_cn: 足以掏空一个富庶城邦数年的储备，若没有领主的支持，安息...

say:60:1064402043:1.text: Bring the Seed of Frost with you, and follow me into the city.
say:60:1064402043:1.source_cn: 带上寒冰之种，随我入城。

say:1:1064403001:0.text: Inside the warm and cozy banquet hall, a sumptuous spread is served on a long table.
say:1:1064403001:0.source_cn: 宴会大厅温暖如春，长桌上摆满了烤鹿肉、可口点心和来自南...

say:2:1064403002:0.text: While the musicians fill the hall with lively tunes, Lord Sno lounges in the seat of honor with two beautiful women in his arms.
say:2:1064403002:0.source_cn: 乐师们弹奏着轻快的旋律，领主斯诺倚靠在主位，怀抱两名美...

say:5:1064403003:0.text: Alna, you're late! Come, have a seat! A hero like you deserves only the finest delicacies!
say:5:1064403003:0.source_cn: 噢——阿尔娜，你可迟到了，坐下暖和暖和，北地的英雄理应...

say:6:1064403004:0.text: My lord, there's an urgent matter that requires your immediate attention.
say:6:1064403004:0.source_cn: 斯诺大人，军务紧急，我有要事禀报。

say:7:1064403005:1.text: Ah, is this about those refugees from the south? They're probably exaggerating things just to get into our city.
say:7:1064403005:1.source_cn: 我听说了，南方来了些流民，为了进城，夸大其词也是常情。

say:8:1064403006:1.text: Who'd be foolish enough to attack in weather like this? Even the bears are holed up in their dens! Come now, Alna. Loosen up and enjoy your moment!
say:8:1064403006:1.source_cn: 但现在可是北地的冬天，连野熊都要缩在窝里，放松些，享受...

say:9:1064403007:1.text: But our scouts have indeed gone missing. When they fail to return on time, it usually means the worst has happened.
say:9:1064403007:1.source_cn: 斥候失踪不是谣言，他们训练有素，逾期不归唯有死讯。

say:10:1064403008:1.text: Allow me to introduce the mage Merlin. She has important information to share.
say:10:1064403008:1.source_cn: 这位是魔法师梅林，她带来了确切情报。

say:12:1064403009:1.text: Lord Sno, I came from the south, where many cities have been ravaged by a Hypogean and its Hypofiend army. Your city is safe for now only because of where it stands.
say:12:1064403009:1.source_cn: 领主大人，恶魔正带领魔物在南方肆虐，北地因偏远才暂得幸免。

say:13:1064403010:1.text: Now they're marching north and will soon reach Resford. I can help—
say:13:1064403010:1.source_cn: 但是，魔潮正向北侵袭，不久后将抵达安息城，我有方法……

say:14:1064403011:1.text: Why should I take your word for it? Only ignorant peasants would fall for your fearmongering!
say:14:1064403011:1.source_cn: 我凭什么信你，就凭你编的破故事？只有吓破胆的农夫才会信。

say:15:1064403012:1.text: My lord, I can vouch for her. Please hear her out.
say:15:1064403012:1.source_cn: 大人，我验证过方法，的确可行。请听她说完。

say:16:1064403013:1.text: Hmph. Fine, let's hear it. What's your solution? A ritual? Or some flashy magic tricks to scare the enemy off?
say:16:1064403013:1.source_cn: 哼，看在阿尔娜的面子上，说吧，是向诸神祈祷，还是弄点发...

say:17:1064403014:1.text: Merlin lays out her plan to raise an ice barrier once again, which requires a substantial amount of glacite.
say:17:1064403014:1.source_cn: 梅林再一次提及冰封之墙计划，并说明需要大量冰蓝晶。

say:18:1064403015:1.text: Glacite?! Do you even know how expensive it is? Not even ten years of our tax revenue could buy the amount you need!
say:18:1064403015:1.source_cn: 行了！冰蓝晶？你知道那是什么价码吗？安息城十年的赋税，...

say:19:1064403016:1.text: That kind of expense would bankrupt Resford! How am I supposed to face the merchants and the nobles?
say:19:1064403016:1.source_cn: 如此规模的资源调动，几乎要掏空城邦仓库，商会、贵族们会...

say:20:1064403017:1.text: What if that barrier doesn't go up, or it doesn't work? I'd lose my fortune for nothing!
say:20:1064403017:1.source_cn: 万一那什么……冰封之墙建不起来，或者建起来没用，我的财...

say:21:1064403018:1.text: Lord Sno, please reconsider. You can always rebuild your wealth, but if your city falls...
say:21:1064403018:1.source_cn: 领主大人，请再考虑，财富可以重新积攒，近在咫尺的灾祸一...

say:22:1064403019:0.text: Enough! Resford is impregnable! Those Hypofiends will freeze to death in the snow!
say:22:1064403019:0.source_cn: 闭嘴！我的城市坚固无比！什么魔物，让它们在雪地里冻死吧。

say:23:1064403020:0.text: Guards! Throw this fraud into the dungeon!
say:23:1064403020:0.source_cn: 卫兵——！把这个骗子抓进地牢！

say:25:1064403021:0.text: As two guards close in on Merlin, Alna steps in front of her, forcing them to back away.
say:25:1064403021:0.source_cn: 两名士兵想要抓住梅林，阿尔娜紧握长枪，以战斗姿态挡在梅...

say:26:1064403022:0.text:
H-How dare you, Alna?!
I'm the ruler of Resford! Defying me is an act of treason! Guards, seize them both!
say:26:1064403022:0.source_cn: 你……你敢抗命？！\n我才是安息城的领主，你要造反吗？...

say:27:1064403023:0.text: As a soldier, my primary duty is to defend Resford, not to obey you!
say:27:1064403023:0.source_cn: 作为士兵，我的首要职责不是效忠领主，而是维护城邦安全！

say:28:1064403024:0.text: If you want Merlin, you'll have to get through my spear first!
say:28:1064403024:0.source_cn: 喝——谁想带走梅林女士，我的长枪不会同意！

say:29:1064403025:0.text: The guards hesitate, none daring to come closer. Merlin shakes her head at Alna, a silent warning not to act rashly.
say:29:1064403025:0.source_cn: 几名卫兵面面相觑，不敢执行命令。梅林对阿尔娜微微摇头，...

say:30:1064403026:0.text: Lord Sno, I certainly hope Resford is as strong as you believe.
say:30:1064403026:0.source_cn: 领主大人，愿安息城，真如您相信的那般坚固。

say:31:1064403027:0.text: Then, Merlin calmly leaves the hall, with Alna at her side.
say:31:1064403027:0.source_cn: 梅林步履平稳地离开了宴会厅，阿尔娜始终紧握长枪，维护在...

say:33:1064403028:0.text: Lord Sno's tirade fades into the background as the music resumes, as though the earlier commotion is nothing more than a passing winter gust.
say:33:1064403028:0.source_cn: 随着领主的咒骂逐渐减弱，乐声重新响起，仿佛刚才的插曲只...

say:37:1064403029:0.text: Merlin, is there something else we could use instead of glacite?
say:37:1064403029:0.source_cn: 梅林女士，是否还有其他材料，可以替代冰蓝晶？

say:38:1064403030:1.text: According to the ancient tome in my collection, the amount of glacite required is fixed.
say:38:1064403030:1.source_cn: 材料的种类与数量，基于古老法籍记载，无法缩减。

say:39:1064403031:1.text:
But...
General Alna, when you tested the ice barrier, did you experience anything unusual?
say:39:1064403031:1.source_cn: 不过……\n阿尔娜将军，您验证冰封之墙时，是否感受到了...

say:40:1064403032:1.text: Alna pauses, her thoughts drifting back to the voice that called to her twice.
say:40:1064403032:1.source_cn: 阿尔娜沉思片刻，她回忆起，此前验证冰封之墙时，曾两次感...

say:41:1064403033:1.text: Actually, I did. I seemed to hear the wind whispering to me, igniting my will to fight. It felt as though some unknown being was calling out to me.
say:41:1064403033:1.source_cn: 没错。仿佛风雪在与我低语，战意被唤醒，有未知之物在呼唤我。

say:42:1064403034:1.text: As I mentioned earlier, the Seed of Frost can resonate with both glacite and those of exceptionally strong will.
say:42:1064403034:1.source_cn: 我曾说过，除了冰蓝晶外，寒冰之种还会与拥有坚韧意志者产...

say:43:1064403035:1.text: In theory, a human could merge with the seed, provided their will is strong enough to resist the Winter Goddess' influence.
say:43:1064403035:1.source_cn: 传说中，与寒冰之种共鸣之人，可尝试与寒冰之种融合，以自...

say:44:1064403036:1.text: If successful, the individual will enter into a <style="highlight">symbiotic bond</style> with the power of winter, gaining the ability to summon snow, conjure ice, and even <style="highlight">become winter itself</style>.
say:44:1064403036:1.source_cn: 若成功，人类将与寒冬之力<style=highligh...

say:45:1064403037:1.text: But the process is excruciating. The divine power will seek to freeze your blood and entomb your soul in ice. Everyone who attempted it before perished in agony.
say:45:1064403037:1.source_cn: 但过程极端痛苦，神性会试图冻结血液、冰封灵魂，此前所有...

say:46:1064403038:1.text: If I succeed, will I be able to repel the Hypofiend army?
say:46:1064403038:1.source_cn: 若我成功，能否抵挡魔物大军？

say:47:1064403039:0.text:
You'll be powerful enough to determine Resford's fate.
I won't sugarcoat it. Your chances of succeeding are slim, while a slow and painful death is far more likely. And if that happens, Resford will lose one of its finest generals.
say:47:1064403039:0.source_cn: 那力量足以改变战局。\n但更可能的是，你会在痛苦中死去...

say:49:1064403041:1.text: As a soldier, I don't take needless risks. <style="highlight">As long as our walls still stand, this isn't a sound option for me</style>.
say:49:1064403041:1.source_cn: 无谓的冒险、牺牲，是对战士生命的亵渎。<style=h...

say:50:1064403042:1.text: Indeed. The decision is entirely yours.
say:50:1064403042:1.source_cn: 正是如此，我不愿操纵任何人的抉择。

say:51:1064403043:1.text: Just then, Merlin's magical device flashes. She studies it for a moment, her expression darkening.
say:51:1064403043:1.source_cn: 这时，梅林的魔法造物闪烁，她沉思片刻，表情凝重。

say:52:1064403044:1.text: I'm sorry, but I've just learned that another city is under attack. I have to leave immediately to help the defenders. Unlike Resford, they have no general like you.
say:52:1064403044:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我收到传讯，有城邦正遭受魔物袭击，我必须赶去协助...

say:53:1064403045:1.text:
I'll be back as soon as I can.
General Alna, the fate of Resford is now in your hands.
say:53:1064403045:1.source_cn: 我会尽快折返。\n阿尔娜将军，安息城的命运，现在握在您...

say:54:1064403046:0.text:
No need to apologize, Merlin. You've already done so much for Resford.
May the wind keep you safe.
say:54:1064403046:0.source_cn: 不必抱歉，你已经为安息城做得足够多了。\n愿寒风护佑你...

narration:57:1064403048:0.text: As soon as Merlin departs, Alna orders the soldiers to assemble at once.
narration:57:1064403048:0.source_cn: 梅林离开后，阿尔娜传令已经休整的军队迅速集结

say:61:1064403049:0.text: An assembly at this hour? There must be an emergency.
say:61:1064403049:0.source_cn: 这么晚集结，一定是有重要军情。

say:62:1064403050:0.text: General Alna wouldn't call the assembly without good reason.
say:62:1064403050:0.source_cn: 将军吹了集结号，就一定有她的理由，不会是为了吓唬我们。

say:66:1064403051:0.text:
I know what's going through your mind.
Winter is a season of respite. You'd think our enemies are settling into warm beds and feasting to their heart's content, just as we are.
say:66:1064403051:0.source_cn: 我知道你们在想什么。\n寒冬，休整期，温暖的被褥，还有...

say:67:1064403052:1.text:
Unfortunately, the enemy we're facing this time feels neither cold nor fatigue!
The refugees have seen how dangerous the Hypofiends are. Now, they're marching our way!
say:67:1064403052:1.source_cn: 但我要告诉你们，敌人不知道寒冷与疲惫！\n流民的哭嚎是...

say:68:1064403053:1.text: Alna's speech silences the murmurs. All eyes turn to her, awaiting her command.
say:68:1064403053:1.source_cn: 没有人再低声议论，士兵们注视阿尔娜，等待命令。

say:69:1064403054:1.text: While my duty is to protect Resford, yours is to trust your comrades!
say:69:1064403054:1.source_cn: 我的职责，是守护安息城！你们的职责，是信任并肩作战的同伴！

say:70:1064403055:1.text:
All units, prepare for battle!
Recall all personnel on leave, inspect all defensive equipment, inventory all arrows, and keep every watchtower manned around the clock!
say:70:1064403055:1.source_cn: 传我命令，全军进入战备状态！\n取消所有休整，检修城防...

say:71:1064403056:1.text: After a moment of silence, someone starts chanting Alna's name, and the others soon join in.
say:71:1064403056:1.source_cn: 短暂的沉默后，有人带头高呼阿尔娜的名字，随后，呼喊声愈...

say:72:1064403057:1.text: Though not everyone is convinced, Alna's long-established reputation still wins over most of the soldiers.
say:72:1064403057:1.source_cn: 尽管并非所有人都已信服，疑虑仍在，但阿尔娜长久以来建立...

say:73:1064403058:1.text: Everyone, raise your weapons and fight for Resford!
say:73:1064403058:1.source_cn: 士兵们，举起武器，为生者奋战！

say:3:1064404001:0.text: Brrr... It's freezing out here! Raymond, toss another log on the fire before your fingers freeze stiff!
say:3:1064404001:0.source_cn: 嘶——呼——这鬼天气……莱默尔，火快灭了，添把柴，别把...

say:5:1064404003:1.text: Beyond the horizon, a dense swarm of dark figures approaches. Their bloodcurdling howls precede them.
say:5:1064404003:1.source_cn: 地平线外，浓稠的黑暗浪潮向安息城推进，非人的嘶吼随风声而来。

say:7:1064404005:0.text: As the horn blares, pounding footsteps and shouted commands erupt from every corner of the city walls.
say:7:1064404005:0.source_cn: 号角吹响，冬夜里，脚步奔跑声、军官嘶吼声，交织碰撞。

say:11:1064404006:0.text:
Stay in formation! Stick to the battle plan!
Nock your arrows and spill the oil! Fire on my command!
say:11:1064404006:0.source_cn: 稳住阵线！记住演练内容！\n箭矢上弦，火油准备，等待我...

say:12:1064404007:0.text: Thanks to the numerous drills, the soldiers quickly snap out of their daze and move into position with practiced precision.
say:12:1064404007:0.source_cn: 得益于提前部署，士兵们很快从短暂的惊愕中回过神来，有条...

say:13:1064404008:0.text: The dark swarm turns out to be a horde of grotesque, humanoid monsters. The moment they reach the city walls, they begin scaling them.
say:13:1064404008:0.source_cn: 黑暗浪潮的轮廓终于清晰：那是由形态扭曲的类人形生物组成...

say:14:1064404009:0.source_cn: 放箭！\n让这些杂碎在雪中淬火！

say:16:1064404010:0.text: Flaming arrows rain down, landing squarely in the oil pooled at the Hypofiends' feet. As the flames roar to life, anguished wails echo through the winter night.
say:16:1064404010:0.source_cn: 火箭离弦，准确地扎入魔物脚下的火油中，火焰升腾，雪夜中...

say:17:1064404011:0.text: Though the first wave of Hypofiends has faltered, countless more press on, undeterred by the hail of arrows.
say:17:1064404011:0.source_cn: 第一波冲击受挫，但魔物的数量依然惊人。它们顶着箭雨，继...

say:18:1064404012:0.text:
Drop the boulders!
Smash their bones to dust!
say:18:1064404012:0.source_cn: 推石！\n我不信他们的骨头比野猪还硬！

say:19:1064404013:0.text: Massive boulders tumble from the walls, crushing the Hypofiends in their path. Yet the survivors remain unfazed. Trampling over the remains of their fallen comrades, they press on.
say:19:1064404013:0.source_cn: 巨型滚石将城墙上的魔物砸倒，但它们似乎不会感到恐惧，踩...

say:21:1064404014:0.text: Hours later, countless frozen corpses have piled up outside Resford.
say:21:1064404014:0.source_cn: 战斗持续了数小时，风雪呼号，数不尽的尸骸堆叠，在极寒的...

say:22:1064404015:0.text: At last, the Hypofiends cease their assault. Many soldiers are still visibly rattled, yet their eyes gleam with the relief of having survived.
say:22:1064404015:0.source_cn: 魔物的第一波攻势终于退去，许多士兵挂着惊魂未定的神情，...

say:25:1064404016:0.text: W-We made it! Resford is safe!
say:25:1064404016:0.source_cn: 我们、我们赢了！安息城守住了！

say:26:1064404017:0.text: It's too early to celebrate! That was only the beginning. The real challenge is yet to come!
say:26:1064404017:0.source_cn: 冷静！这只是一次试探，真正的风暴尚未到来！

say:27:1064404018:0.text: Take stock of the casualties. Replenish the arrows and boulders. Stay alert, everyone!
say:27:1064404018:0.source_cn: 清点伤亡，补充箭矢滚石。所有人，保持警惕！

narration:33:1064404020:0.text: The next three days see Resford become a sea of blood.
narration:33:1064404020:0.source_cn: 接下来三天，安息城陷入血色风暴中……

say:35:1064404021:0.text: Day and night, the Hypofiends attack without pause. Flying Hypofiends rain acid from above, while gigantic ones hurl themselves against the city gates again and again.
say:35:1064404021:0.source_cn: 魔物不分昼夜地发动攻击，潮水般的冲锋混杂着难以预料的偷...

say:36:1064404022:0.text: Under Alna's command, the soldiers hold off wave after wave of Hypofiends. But each victory comes at a cost as casualties mount and supplies dwindle.
say:36:1064404022:0.source_cn: 在阿尔娜的指挥下，顽强的守军一次次击退魔物，但伤亡数量...

say:37:1064404023:0.text: After Lord Sno repeatedly refuses her requests for reinforcements, Alna has no choice but to ask other cities for help...
say:37:1064404023:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜多次派人向领主寻求援助，均遭到拒绝，她只能派出多...

say:42:1064404024:0.text: General, none of our five scout teams made it back... It's crawling with Hypofiends out there! There's no way we can get help from the other cities!
say:42:1064404024:0.source_cn: 将军，派出去的五队兄弟，都没回来……城外到处都是魔物，...

say:43:1064404025:0.text: None of our soldiers have abandoned their posts, but we're running low on medicine and weapons...
say:43:1064404025:0.source_cn: 没有一个士兵离开阵地，但药物、武器已经快见底了……

say:44:1064404026:0.text: Frustrated, Alna slams her fist against the city wall. Then, a thunderous roar in the distance plunges her into even deeper despair. It comes from the Hypogean, a creature far stronger and more intelligent than any Hypofiend.
say:44:1064404026:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜愤然锤向城墙，更绝望的是，城外传来声音，它来自比...

say:48:1064404027:0.text:
Heed the will of the abyss, weaklings!
Tomorrow, we unleash our full might! I'll reduce this city to rubble and tear every soul apart!
say:48:1064404027:0.source_cn: 脆弱的蝼蚁，聆听深渊的意志！\n明日，总攻开始！我将踏...

say:49:1064404028:0.text: Consider this my mercy. Open the gates and surrender now, and I'll let you live.
say:49:1064404028:0.source_cn: 但，仁慈的深渊，给予你们一个选择——立刻打开城门，跪地...

say:52:1064404029:1.text: Alna looks over her shoulder. Some soldiers tighten their grip on their weapons, while others curse under their breath. Yet none of them leave the line.
say:52:1064404029:1.source_cn: 阿尔娜望向身后，有人沉默地握紧武器，有人低声咒骂，但队...

say:53:1064404030:1.text:
This is what I like to see, soldiers!
As long as we stand, Resford will never fall!
say:53:1064404030:1.source_cn: 好样的，士兵们！\n今夜，明日，每一刻，安息城，永不陷落！

say:54:1064404031:1.text: Let's send this wicked Hypogean and its minions back to the abyss!
say:54:1064404031:1.source_cn: 与我一起，把恶魔和它的渣滓们送回深渊！

say:55:1064404032:0.text: Alna understands that morale alone cannot win the battle. Leaving her deputy in command, she seeks out Lord Sno to secure more supplies.
say:55:1064404032:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜明白，仅靠军队顽强的意志，不足以赢得战争。她安排...

say:59:1064404034:0.text: General Alna, His Lordship is so worried about the city that he has fallen ill. I'm afraid this isn't a suitable time to disturb him.
say:59:1064404034:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜将军，领主大人忧心城防，以致身体欠安，现在不便打扰呢。

say:60:1064404035:0.text:
I don't have time for your nonsense!
My soldiers are barely holding on! I need more supplies to sustain the fight!
say:60:1064404035:0.source_cn: 我没有时间与你玩弄唇舌！\n士兵在流血，我需要物资援助！

say:61:1064404036:0.text: We cannot simply allocate resources without careful deliberation! Lord Sno wouldn't want his wealth wasted on—
say:61:1064404036:0.source_cn: 您此前一意孤行，物资派遣自然得多加考量，领主大人的财富...

say:67:1064404038:1.text: Alna wipes the blood from her spear, steps over Pantheus' lifeless body, and heads deeper into the castle.
say:67:1064404038:1.source_cn: 阿尔娜抹去枪上的鲜血，迈过平图斯的尸体，走向城堡深处。

say:68:1064404039:0.text: Lord Sno is nowhere to be found in the castle. A secret passage leading beyond the city has collapsed into a heap of rubble, and the air still carries the faint scent of gunpowder.
say:68:1064404039:0.source_cn: 城堡各处不见领主踪影，只有一条通往城外的密道，此时已被...

say:69:1064404040:0.text: Looks like Lord Sno made his escape, then blew up the passage behind him to cover his tracks.
say:69:1064404040:0.source_cn: 看来，为了防止追击，领主在逃跑后已将地道炸毁。

say:70:1064404041:0.text: You. Bring me to the vault!

say:72:1064404042:0.text: His Lordship... I mean, Sno took everything in the vault with him before he fled...
say:72:1064404042:0.source_cn: 领主大人……不不，斯诺他、他在逃跑时，已经将财库搬空了……

say:73:1064404043:0.text: Did he take the glacite too?

say:74:1064404044:1.text: Y-Yes... Anything he couldn't take, he ordered us to burn it... Please don't kill me...
say:74:1064404044:1.source_cn: 是、是的……带不走的物资，他命令我们全部烧掉……求大人...

say:75:1064404045:0.text:
Shame on you!
Your cowardice will destroy Resford! You don't deserve to wear a soldier's uniform!
say:75:1064404045:0.source_cn: 耻辱！\n你们的胆怯，会摧毁安息城！愧为战士！

say:77:1064404046:0.text: Alna ignores the guard and returns to the front lines. She says nothing of Lord Sno's escape, unwilling to undermine the army's morale.
say:77:1064404046:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜没有理会下跪乞怜的守卫，她返回战线，下令封锁领主...

say:81:1064404048:0.text: Outside the city, the Hypofiends gather in silence, yet make no move to attack. Their Hypogean leader steps forward, dragging Lord Sno behind him.
say:81:1064404048:0.source_cn: 魔物军队不断集结，但似乎并不急于进攻。不久后，恶魔统领...

say:83:1064404049:0.text: Take a good look at this coward you've been serving all along!
say:83:1064404049:0.source_cn: 呵……看看你们所愚忠之人！

say:85:1064404050:0.text: I-I'm Lord Sno! Open the gates now! Do it, and they'll spare our lives!
say:85:1064404050:0.source_cn: 我、我是你们的领主！我命令你们，打开城门！它们答应了，...

say:89:1064404051:0.text: Is that... Lord Sno?! Shouldn't he be inside the city?
say:89:1064404051:0.source_cn: 那是……斯诺大人？！他不是在安息城里吗？

say:90:1064404052:0.text: I can't believe he'd give an order like that!
say:90:1064404052:0.source_cn: 身为领主，他怎么能说出这样的话！

say:94:1064404053:0.text: That man isn't our ruler! He's just a coward who has betrayed us all!
say:94:1064404053:0.source_cn: 那不是领主，只是一个叛誓的懦夫！

say:95:1064404054:0.text: Alna raises her bow and looses an arrow straight through Sno's throat.
say:95:1064404054:0.source_cn: 话音刚落，阿尔娜张弓搭箭，箭矢窜出，精准地贯穿领主咽喉。

say:99:1064404055:0.text: I, Alna, have executed the traitor for the people of Resford!
say:99:1064404055:0.source_cn: 我，阿尔娜，以安息城尊严的名义，已将叛城者处决！

say:100:1064404056:0.text: As Sno's body slumps to the ground, the Hypogean stares at it in stunned disbelief. Clearly, Alna's decisive action has caught him completely off guard.
say:100:1064404056:0.source_cn: 恶魔统领震惊地看向已无生气的领主，它没有想到阿尔娜会如...

say:101:1064404057:0.text: Lieutenant Dunn is the first to recover from the shock. He raises his sword, and the rest of the soldiers soon follow.
say:101:1064404057:0.source_cn: 军队先是出现短暂的静默，随后，副将邓恩率先举剑，余下士...

say:103:1064404059:0.text:
Rise, warriors of the northern lands!
Fight for Resford!
say:103:1064404059:0.source_cn: 向前，北地人！\n凛冬已至，为安息城奋战！

say:107:1064404060:1.text: This time, the Hypofiends attack with unprecedented ferocity. The walls are breached at multiple points, allowing the Hypofiends to pour into the city. The streets and plazas soon fill with the screams of terrified civilians.
say:107:1064404060:1.source_cn: 总攻比以往猛烈数倍，城墙多处失守，魔物们涌进安息城，街...

say:108:1064404061:0.text: Alna gives her all to defending the city, but she is no match for the Hypofiends... Resford, the city she vowed to protect, is falling...
say:108:1064404061:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜挥舞冰枪，但人类的力量难以抵抗魔潮……安息城，她...

say:109:1064404062:0.text: At that moment, Alna hears the Seed of Frost calling to her once again... <style="highlight">The time has come for her to merge with it</style>.
say:109:1064404062:0.source_cn: 这时，阿尔娜感到寒冰之种的呼唤再度出现，强盛空前……<...

say:112:1064404063:0.text: As long as there are soldiers left, these walls will never fall!
say:112:1064404063:0.source_cn: 安息城尚有战士，城墙……便不会倒下！

say:114:1064404064:0.text: The ancient power of winter surges into Alna's chest and courses through her veins... It freezes her blood, encases her bones in ice, and tears every muscle in her body apart...
say:114:1064404064:0.source_cn: 世界诞生之初的凛冬本源，从阿尔娜的胸口钻入，顺着血管蔓...

say:115:1064404065:0.text: Alna opens her mouth, but can't find her voice... Her throat has been sealed by snow.
say:115:1064404065:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜张开嘴，却发不出任何声音……她的喉咙已覆满冬雪。

say:1:1064405001:0.text: The few remaining soldiers stand back to back, their ragged breaths cutting through the tense silence. Hypofiends surround them on all sides, yet not one of them lowers their weapon.
say:1:1064405001:0.source_cn: 风雪中，所剩无几的士兵背靠背，呼吸沉重，魔物已将他们...

say:4:1064405003:0.text: As the Hypofiend's claws slash through Raymond's arm, Russell swiftly hacks off its arm. Raymond cries out in pain but refuses to fall.
say:4:1064405003:0.source_cn: 一只魔物利爪贯穿莱默尔的手臂，罗塞挥剑将其斩断，前者发...

say:7:1064405005:0.text: Noticing the soldiers' broken weapons, the Hypofiends sense their chance to deal the killing blow...
say:7:1064405005:0.source_cn: 当士兵们的武器卷刃、绽出裂纹，魔物准备发出致命一击时……

say:8:1064405006:0.text: Suddenly, a deafening roar changes everything... Wind and snow converge into a cloak that drapes a towering figure.
say:8:1064405006:0.source_cn: 一声怒吼撕裂凛冬……无尽风雪聚作战袍，披挂在一个高大的...

say:12:1064405007:0.text: Standing before Russell and Raymond, Alna raises her hand, instantly restoring their weapons with ice.
say:12:1064405007:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜矗立在二人身前，抬手，锐利的寒冰覆上士兵们残破的...

say:13:1064405008:0.text: You are both honorable soldiers. The northern wind will remember your names.
say:13:1064405008:0.source_cn: 你们没有辜负战士的身份，北风会铭记这一刻。

say:14:1064405009:1.text: Now, raise your weapons and charge with me!
say:14:1064405009:1.source_cn: 现在，举起武器，随我冲锋！

say:15:1064405010:0.text: The blustery wind sweeping over Resford suddenly changes its direction. Riding the gale, Alna hurls herself into the sea of Hypofiends!
say:15:1064405010:0.source_cn: 吹向安息城的寒风，在此刻转向。阿尔娜乘着倒卷的寒风，冲...

say:19:1064405011:0.text: Foolish mortal, I'll reserve the worst spot in the abyss for your soul!
say:19:1064405011:0.source_cn: 不自量力的凡人，我会在深渊，为你的灵魂挑选一个饱受折磨...

say:23:1064405014:0.text: An icy spear pierces the Hypogean, freezing it into an ice sculpture that shatters the next instant.
say:23:1064405014:0.source_cn: 冰枪贯穿恶魔统领，它的身躯冻结为一座冰雕，随后在寒风中粉碎。

say:25:1064405015:0.text: Alna dances gracefully, every movement unleashing a deadly blizzard that slays the Hypofiends.
say:25:1064405015:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜在风雪中起舞，每一个动作都牵引出一片冰封的死亡，...

say:26:1064405016:0.text: The surviving soldiers regroup and follow closely behind Alna. Locking their cracked shields into a wall and leveling their broken spears, they drive into the Hypofiends.
say:26:1064405016:0.source_cn: 残存士兵重整队列，裂盾并作盾墙，断矛前指，追随阿尔娜的...

say:29:1064405017:0.text: For General Alna! For Resford! Charge!
say:29:1064405017:0.source_cn: 为了阿尔娜将军！为了安息城！冲啊——！

say:32:1064405019:0.text: Leaderless, the Hypofiends are utterly routed by Alna and the soldiers.
say:32:1064405019:0.source_cn: 失去了恶魔统领，在阿尔娜与剩余士兵的打击下，魔物大军彻...

say:33:1064405020:0.text: The Hypofiends... They're gone! We did it!
say:33:1064405020:0.source_cn: 魔物……魔物真的被打退了！安息城守住了！

say:34:1064405021:0.text: It's all because of General Alna! ... Wait, where's she? She was just here...
say:34:1064405021:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜将军！是她救了我们……欸，将军呢？刚才还能看到……

say:35:1064405022:0.text: The surviving soldiers help one another to their feet. The wind still howls, but Alna has vanished without a trace.
say:35:1064405022:0.source_cn: 幸存士兵相互搀扶，阿尔娜不知何时已然消失，只有寒风依然盘旋。

narration:38:1064405023:0.text: Three days later, Merlin returns to Resford, now a peaceful, warm city.
narration:38:1064405023:0.source_cn: 三天后，梅林赶回复归平静的安息城

say:41:1064405024:0.text: Merlin faces the biting wind and speaks softly, as if conversing with winter itself.
say:41:1064405024:0.source_cn: 梅林面对寒风，轻声开口，仿佛在与凛冬对话。

say:42:1064405025:0.text: Alna, from this day forward, you have become the embodiment of winter.
say:42:1064405025:0.source_cn: 阿尔娜，从此之后，你的意志将与风雪同频，你的足迹将随寒...

say:43:1064405026:0.text: Cold and solitude will be your lifelong companions. Do you regret your choice?
say:43:1064405026:0.source_cn: 四季轮转，与你相随的，皆是与温暖背离的孤寂。你是否后悔？

say:44:1064405027:0.text: The wind falls still for a brief moment. Then, an authoritative voice drifts from the swirling snow...
say:44:1064405027:0.source_cn: 呼啸的寒风似乎凝结了片刻，随后，一个威严的声音自雪花晶...

say:45:1064405028:0.text:
No. Even the strongest city walls will one day crumble.
I'd rather strike first with my spear.
say:45:1064405028:0.source_cn: 不。固守的城墙，终有被侵蚀磨灭的一刻。\n而我，更愿成...

say:46:1064405029:0.text: As the voice fades away, the blizzard that has battered Resford for days finally subsides. Sunlight spills through the clouds, enveloping the entire city in warmth.
say:46:1064405029:0.source_cn: 声音消散的刹那，笼罩安息城多日的风雪拂散，阳光破云而出...
